title: Thysius / Leyden: justification sometimes seems to embrace sanctification
source_text: XIII. Anthonius Thysius etiam in Synopsi purioris Theologiae Professorum Leydensium, Disp. 33. Thesi 5. testatur in eadem se esse sententia: Neque tamen diffitemur, inquit, propter summam & arctissimam connexionem, justificationem quoque sanctificationem ipsam, ut consequens, videri nonnunquam complecti. Rom. 8. 30. Tit. 3. 7. &c.
pass_a_gloss: Anthonius Thysius also in the Synopsis of purer Theology of the Leyden Professors, Disp. 33 thesis 5, testifies that he is of the same opinion: Yet we do not deny, he says, that because of the highest and closest connection, justification also sometimes seems to embrace sanctification itself as a consequent. Rom. 8:30. Tit. 3:7. etc.
pass_b_english: Leyden Thysius: given tight connection, justification sometimes seems to embrace sanctification as consequent.
